title: LED
text: 连接与硬件板上 LED 相连的信号，输入 1 路；按 {Hardware board} 指定查看所选硬件；{View LEDs location} 指定查看 LED、{IO logic} 指定 IO 逻辑指示器、{Number of LEDs} 指定 LED 端口数量，按实例取值。

params.name: Hardware board
params.values: 查看所选硬件 None (default) | Supported Xilinx ® or Intel ® boards | Custom boards

params.name: IO logic
params.values: IO 逻辑指示器 None (default) | Active High | Active Low

params.name: Number of LEDs
params.values: LED 端口数量 1 (default) | list of integers in the range [1, n ]
